title: Repository Identity Check
description: Verifies repository identity, default branch, protected branch, and execution mode assumptions.
intent: Typed repository-identity validation request with evidence.
outcome: Machine-readable RepoIdentityRecord with verified identity, branch, mode, and reason codes.
constraints: Repository identity must be deterministic and verifiable.
Default branch, protected branch, and execution mode must match verified source.
Mismatched or incomplete evidence must cause fail-closed rejection.

reason_codes.REPO_MISMATCH: Repository identity does not match verified source.
reason_codes.DEFAULT_BRANCH_MISMATCH: Default branch does not match verified source.
reason_codes.PROTECTED_BRANCH_MISMATCH: Protected branch does not match verified source.
reason_codes.EXECUTION_MODE_MISMATCH: Execution mode does not match verified environment.
reason_codes.EVIDENCE_GAP: Required evidence is missing or incomplete.
reason_codes.MALFORMED_INPUT: Input structure is invalid or missing required fields.
